name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilizers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd in the business of manufacturing and trading of Chemicals and Fertilisers[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
SPCFL manufactures Dyes, Dye Intermediates, Fertilizers, Soil Conditioners, Reactive Dyes and Textile Chemicals. 
Company has 14 offices nationwide with direct Marketing via 600+ dealers and own distribution channels

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 9.56% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 12.2% of profits over last 3 years
